title: Smoked Satay Lamb-Free Skewers
description: A Malaysian-inspired vegetarian take on the classic street food, using smoked tofu and a variety of colorful vegetables.

ingredients.name: smoked tofu
ingredients.amount: 1 block, drained and cut into 1-inch cubes

ingredients.name: skewers
ingredients.amount: 10-12 bamboo skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes

instructions: Thread the smoked tofu, red bell pepper, yellow onion, and zucchini onto the skewers.
In a small bowl, whisk together the coconut oil, honey, soy sauce, rice vinegar, coriander, and cumin.
Brush the mixture evenly onto both sides of the skewers.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender and lightly charred.
Optional: Grill the skewers for 5-7 minutes per side, or until lightly charred.
Note: If using a grill, preheat to medium-high heat.
